claim: When replacing a plotter, reproduce its exact end state (registers, flags, stack push, self-modified operands); running the original once over a mapped RAM canvas page is a way to get the exact register state.

evidence.text: Plotters A and B are converted to sprites; they self-modify 43232/43260 and 61359 and PUSH AF on the game stack with no DI (4,299 A and 1,058 B plots converted in the RZX).
evidence.quote: self-mods 43232/43260, 61359 (x/8). PUSH AF on the game stack; no DI.

evidence.text: The original plotter is run once over canvas RAM page 29 for the exact register state, then the sprite attributes are staged; AF' may hold a canvas byte, which verify proves dies.
